name: Hernyék (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and red at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hernyék: a blue and green shield with a church, a tree and a red charge, inscribed HERNYÉK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
